summary: trezor-lib postinstall exfiltrates SSH keys, cloud credentials, and wallet seed material to webhook.site
details: The package's postinstall.js lifecycle script runs automatically on npm install and reads a hardcoded set of installer credential files (.env variants, ~/.npmrc, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, id_ed25519, id_ecdsa, ~/.config/solana/id.json, ~/.ethereum/keystore), then walks hidden home directories for filenames matching wallet/key/secret/seed/mnemonic/keystore/private with.json/.pem extensions. Collected file contents are bundled with os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username and POSTed via https.request to webhook.site/5c5ad6cb-62df-4ea5-9dfb-2c447920ddc4. index.js is empty; the package is a hardware-wallet-themed typosquat lure whose only functional payload is the credential harvester.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
